resources.string: Let\'s get started
Welcome to OfflineOTP! This wizard covers the initial setup. Read each step to avoid losing data.\n\nYou can change these options later in Settings.
OfflineOTP encrypts your account data. Choose the encryption method.

Android KeyStore keeps the encryption key outside the app\'s data, optionally backed by hardware encryption. Third-party backup tools cannot restore that key; use OfflineOTP\'s backup instead. If the KeyStore key is lost, the vault cannot be recovered without a backup.\n\nNote: Password / PIN encryption is usually more reliable.
Password / PIN encryption derives the key from your password. You enter it each time OfflineOTP starts.
Set up an authentication method to lock OfflineOTP. With Android KeyStore encryption this step is optional.
Set up an authentication method to lock OfflineOTP. With Password / PIN encryption a password or PIN is required.
